faq_heading: East Central houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in East Central. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

East Central, Maple Ridge: 82 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 1 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in East Central rose from 72 in June to 82 in September (+13.9%), and 36 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 20.0% of Maple Ridge’s 410 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in East Central?
East Central also had 120 condos and townhomes listed and 11 sold in September, against 82 houses listed. The East Central condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: East Central home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

79 houses sold in East Central with a median price of $1,100,000 (the middle half sold between $975,000 and $1,212,500), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $505 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median lot of 6,372 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in East Central?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 82 houses listed in East Central. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is East Central a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in East Central had a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in East Central from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 36 houses sold in East Central over those 4 months, out of 188 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in East Central?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in East Central sell for?
faq.a: 79 houses sold in East Central between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,100,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in East Central?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
